text: The 2023 tree removal within the 58.1-hectare rural property involved the loss of approximately 0.7 hectares of tree cover, primarily from a 0.4-hectare eucalyptus plantation. Earth-observation data confirms the loss occurred, but it does not provide evidence about whether the removal was authorized. The evidence does not indicate the cause (e.g., legal harvesting, unauthorized clearing, or natural disturbance) or establish compliance with regulations. Further investigation into local permits, land-use records, or regulatory filings would be needed to determine if the removal was authorized.
